prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a physician and a receptionist had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the physician and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of marijuana. After the receptionist's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. The receptionist
B. Can't be determined
C. The physician
